name: nse-day-trader-skill
description: The Day Trader skill pack for Indian markets (NSE/BSE), combining Jake Schincariol's Day Trader skill with TradingAgents' research committee

plugins.name: nse-day-trader-skill
plugins.description: Sixteen Claude skills for trading NSE/BSE: an index option chain and option-buying planner for NIFTY 50 and SENSEX, a TradingAgents-style research committee (analysts, bull vs bear, risk debate, Buy-to-Sell rating), a decision journal scored against NIFTY, a technical-indicator snapshot, a chart scanner (NIFTY 500 or every EQ stock), a news monitor with NSE filings, an entry timer, an exit planner on NSE's tick grid, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager with Indian trading costs, a Zerodha Kite order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts on the NSE clock, an earnings analyst and a bulk and block deals tracker.
